purpose: decide whether a candidate dataset can support the three-wave source-loss leverage test before any future occupancy outcome is opened

detectability_gate.preferred: replicated surveys or an explicit detection/non-detection design
detectability_gate.acceptable_if_absent: single-visit occupancy only if the source publication/data documentation justifies comparable effort and the limitation is frozen before response access

source_loss_estimability_precheck.metadata_only_question: does the design plausibly contain repeated island occupancy with possible source loss events and later target follow-up?

independence_gate.shared_geography_with_existing_system: allowed only if biological response and temporal process are genuinely independent and the intended evidence class is declared non-independent geographically

outcomes.QUALIFIED_METADATA_ONLY: candidate may proceed to system-specific v0.31-style partition/estimability freeze; future response remains sealed
outcomes.HOLD_METADATA_INCOMPLETE: missing metadata may be resolved without opening response values
outcomes.STOP_RESPONSE_EXPOSED: future outcome already inspected for the proposed hypothesis
outcomes.STOP_NONINDEPENDENT_RESPONSE: reuses an existing Structural biological response

anti_selection: do not choose a candidate because published results suggest a favourable leverage effect
do not inspect t2 occupancy to decide whether the candidate is worth using
do not select taxa by known persistence after source loss
do not loosen the three-wave requirement because a two-wave dataset is convenient
do not use a candidate publication's fitted connectivity coefficient as intake evidence
